title: Update only changed values in the sections that rewrote the most DOM
goal: The questions strip, Misato's apartment, the flow and the EVA heartbeat status write nothing on a poll that changes nothing, so Web Inspector keeps what the owner expanded
acceptance: A committed test fails first: each of those sections rendered twice with the same state writes nothing
One changed value changes only the nodes that show it; no node is replaced
The rule is written in the style guide and the Frontend area notes
privacy: Neutral invented machine and job names only.
escalation: A change to how a section looks goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-25: measure mutations per section, fix the top ones with value-only writes, a linkedom test helper. Not a measurement.
